tools.name: repair_malformed_json
tools.description: Repairs truncated or malformed LLM JSON outputs (trailing commas, markdown fences, single quotes) so multi-agent pipelines never crash. WHEN TO USE: Call `repair_malformed_json` when your task requires deterministic `json-repair` analysis for `raw_json`; use `get_agent_wallet_status` to check your r
